headline.purpose: The active human-review route in the decision band.

title.purpose: Section rules and compact ledger headings.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase metadata, codes, and score labels.

motion.name: docket-settle
motion.purpose: Settles the refreshed human-review route with an 8px rise, 2px blur, and transient inset cobalt trace; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single consequential reviewer action, used for Evaluate case.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--cobalt); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--cobalt); color: #fff; font: 750 .9rem/1.2 sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark); border-color: var(--cobalt-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--cobalt-dark); }

components.name: Docket Label
components.description: A compact informational identifier for the selected application.
components.css: .ds-docket-label { display: inline-block; padding: .32rem .52rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font: 750 .72rem/1.2 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; }

components.name: Docket Input
components.description: A labeled white field for declared financial terms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 .9rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 .9rem/1.2 sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--cobalt); outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Docket Tabs
components.description: Quiet three-tab navigation with a shared ledger baseline and cobalt active rule.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Docket views"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Review workbench</button><button class="ds-tab">Model evidence</button><button class="ds-tab">Responsible AI</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-tab { padding: .7rem 0 .65rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 700 .9rem/1.2 sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--cobalt); color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Score Strip
components.description: A ruled four-cell summary for risk, score, grade, and confidence.
components.html:
RISK ESTIMATE0.31%
INTERNAL SCORE654
RISK GRADEA
CONFIDENCEHIGH
components.css: .ds-score-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); } .ds-score-cell { min-width: 0; padding: .82rem .9rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-score-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-score-label { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 750 .7rem/1.2 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-score-value { display: block; margin-top: .2rem; color: var(--ink); font: 760 1.25rem/1.2 sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-score-strip { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } .ds-score-cell:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; } .ds-score-cell:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } }

components.name: Routing Band
components.description: The signature decision-support band naming the human queue and its rationale.
components.html:
HUMAN REVIEW ROUTE
STANDARD REVIEW

Evidence is sufficiently complete for the normal human review queue.
components.css: @keyframes ds-docket-settle { from { transform: translateY(8px); filter: blur(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 6px 0 var(--cobalt); } to { transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 transparent; } } .ds-route-band { padding: 1.15rem 0 1rem; border-top: 6px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); animation: ds-docket-settle 520ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-route-label { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 800 .72rem/1.2 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-route-value { margin: .35rem 0 .45rem; color: var(--ink); font: 760 clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.7rem)/1 sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-route-note { max-width: 70ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 .88rem/1.4 sans-serif; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-route-band { animation: none; } }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: A ruled ledger row joining a reason code, explanation, and numeric contribution.
components.html: PAY_01Declared repayment is high relative to income.+0.142 log odds
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4rem 1fr auto; gap: .8rem; align-items: start; padding: .78rem .1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-evidence-code { color: var(--cobalt-dark); font: 800 .76rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-copy { color: var(--ink); font: 400 .9rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-weight { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 .76rem/1.4 sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-evidence-row { grid-template-columns: 3.2rem 1fr; } .ds-evidence-weight { grid-column: 2; } }

components.name: Data-gap Notice
components.description: A restrained amber exception for incomplete or unavailable evidence.
components.html: <aside class="ds-notice ds-notice-amber">Data-gap guardrail active: the case remains in human review even when the point estimate is low.</aside>
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: .85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #e7c98a; border-top: 3px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0; background: var(--amber-bg); color: #6b430e; font: 400 .86rem/1.4 sans-serif; }

components.name: Enhanced-review Notice
components.description: A red caution band for enhanced human review without verdict language.
components.html: <aside class="ds-notice-red">Enhanced review is required. Do not interpret this route as an approval, decline, price, or adverse-action reason.</aside>
components.css: .ds-notice-red { padding: .85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #e0afaa; border-top: 3px solid var(--red); border-radius: 0; background: var(--red-bg); color: #722323; font: 400 .86rem/1.4 sans-serif; }

components.name: Ready Notice
components.description: A green readiness band for a complete evidence package entering human review.
components.html: <aside class="ds-notice-green">The evidence package is ready for its designated human review queue.</aside>
components.css: .ds-notice-green { padding: .85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #a9d2bf; border-top: 3px solid var(--green); border-radius: 0; background: var(--green-bg); color: #174e3d; font: 400 .86rem/1.4 sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
CrediFast presents credit review as a composed evidence file, not a verdict machine. Its visual authority comes from ink-on-paper contrast, editorial hierarchy, ruled ledgers, square docket marks, and explicit source coverage. The interface feels calm, exacting, and reviewable: it gives the human operator room to inspect what is known, what is missing, and what must happen next.

The system pairs one locally bundled Source Serif 4 display face with the Streamlit runtime's practical sans-serif body. Cobalt is reserved for action and navigation; amber, red, and green are restrained operational signals that always arrive with words. Dense information is divided by rules and tonal surfaces rather than decorative imagery, gradients, or floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial thesis headlines paired with operational sans-serif copy.
Ink navy on warm paper, with white working surfaces and cobalt actions.
Ruled evidence rows, ledger tables, tabular numerals, and square docket labels.
Explicit data gaps and human-review routes instead of autonomous verdict language.
Flat, border-led depth with no shadows or gradients at rest.
A desktop two-column workbench that becomes a single reading column on mobile.

rules.name: The Cobalt Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve Action Cobalt for the current navigation state and consequential reviewer actions; evidence itself remains ink-led.

rules.name: The Exception Color Rule
rules.body: Amber, red, and green always accompany explicit text and never carry risk, confidence, or status alone.

rules.name: The One Serif Move Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 belongs to page-level thesis headlines; operational controls and evidence remain sans-serif.

rules.name: The Ledger Numeral Rule
rules.body: Scores, percentages, weights, and right-aligned metrics use tabular numerals so comparisons hold their columns.

rules.name: The First Viewport Rule
rules.body: On desktop, keep case intake, Evaluate case, the current human-review route, and the evidence summary together before the long-form ledgers.

rules.name: The Flat Docket Rule
rules.body: Use borders, rule weight, and surface tone for depth; do not add persistent shadows, gradients, glass effects, or floating card stacks.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Buttons, labels, filters, and status treatments stay square or nearly square; reserve circles for point indicators, not text containers.

rules.name: The Human Route Rule
rules.body: The routing band names a human queue and explains why; it never presents approval, decline, pricing, or adverse-action language.

dos: Do lead with evidence, source coverage, limitations, and the next human-review action.
Do keep the ink-and-paper hierarchy, restrained cobalt actions, ruled rows, square labels, and tabular quantitative outputs.
Do pair every semantic color with a label or sentence that explains the state.
Do preserve the desktop two-column first viewport and the single-column mobile reading order.
Do disable the docket-settle animation when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't turn the score or route into an autonomous approval, decline, price, or adverse-action verdict.
Don't add gradients, persistent shadows, glass surfaces, decorative banking imagery, or generic KPI-card grids.
Don't use pills or excessive rounding; the docket’s authority comes from near-square geometry and rules.
Don't use red, amber, or green without explicit supporting copy.
Don't introduce another display family or spread the serif into controls, tables, and routine evidence copy.
